cold showers are not it
Nights start tonight so I'm sleeping now lol. Ask the ward, they have a huge kettle
u still at the hospital tonight?
nvm. saw you're on till morning

someone's here. guy's at the door w a bag of tools
he says it's a thermocouple or something. he's checking

and "the call-out fee" which is 250 so 430 total. landlord can pay it he owes me a boiler

will do. sleep well

430. landlord says he'll take it off rent. we'll see
Get it in writing 😂
i literally have the receipt lol

lmao

ok. patient mode
[photo: pot of harira, slightly grey]
it's edible i promise
